observations: Spelling of the Name matches the scan: יְהֹוָה in full through Ex15:19, and the abbreviated יְיָ / לַייָ in the repeat of 15:18 and in the closing verses.

Defective vs. full spelling matches in Ex15:18: לְעֹלָם (defective) in the verse itself, לְעוֹלָם (full) in the repeat. Other defective and full spellings also match: תְהִלֹּת, יַעֲבֹר, בִּגְדֹל, יֹשְׁבֵי, כַּעוֹפֶרֶת, זְרוֹעֲךָ, מָכוֹן, כּוֹנְנוּ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ.
The repeat of 15:18 and the closing verses are printed with vowels but no cantillation, which matches the primary.
The scan has punctuation that the primary leaves out: a period after הַיָּם in the middle of Ex15:19, a raised dot after הַהוּא, a dot after וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ, and a raised dot after לֵאמֹר.

The vertical stacks of dots seen above some word gaps (s90-b0 lines 2 and 6, s90-b2 line 2) appear to be the zaqef on the end of the previous word sitting next to the holam of the next word. They don't look like separate signs.

At this resolution, most meteg/silluq marks and conjunctive accents (munah, merkha, mahpakh, darga) can be read only as 'a mark is present'. They aren't clearly told apart from one another. Verses listed as verified mean no discrepancy was found, not that every accent was confirmed. A higher-resolution scan is needed to settle the pending items.
